description: This file defines a React component for publishing notes to the web, including a dialog and popup view for managing monograph details such as title, self-destruct option, password, and analytics. It interacts with a database, external APIs, and UI components to facilitate publishing and unpublishing notes.

classes.name: PublishView
classes.description: React component for displaying and managing the publish view, including monograph link, title, self-destruct toggle, password, and publish/unpublish actions.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Unmounts the React root used for the publish popup.

methods.name: showPublishView
methods.description: Displays the publish view popup for a given note, rendering the PublishView component inside a popup presenter.

methods.name: resolveMonograph
methods.description: Fetches and decrypts monograph details from the database based on monograph ID.
